$comment: NBA 2K does not display a 'total build points' number in the builder UI; the constraint is
expressed through per-attribute caps and escalating upgrade costs. This app models the spend
budget explicitly because an optimizer needs one. If 2K27 turns out to have no shared budget at
all, set `enabled` to false and the engine will optimize against caps alone.
budget = base + perInchHeight*(h-ref) + perPoundWeight*(w-ref) + perInchWingspan*(ws-ref) + positionAdjust

verification.notes: The entire budget concept and every number here is invented.

notes: Body modifiers are all zero on purpose: in the NBA 2K series body settings move CAPS, not the
spending pool. They are exposed here anyway so you can model a budget effect if 2K27 has one.
`base` is calibrated against the invented cost curves in cost-curves.json so that a plausible
full build — four or five elite attributes plus a functional spread everywhere else — is exactly
affordable. It is a joint fiction with those curves: changing one without the other will make
